title: Micro-Manager flip mirror managerProperties
description: One Micro-Manager device presented as an ImSwitch2 flip mirror, a switch with N named positions: a State device with two or more positions (a flip mount, a filter wheel, an objective turret, a multi-way light path), or a Shutter presented as a two-state switch (closed is state 0, open is state 1). Every position of a State device is state of the same number (Micro-Manager's state index) and is named by its Micro-Manager state label unless 'state_names' renames it. 'invert', 'initial_state' and 'state_names' are fields of the flip-mirror entry itself, not of managerProperties; 'invert' applies to two-state devices only. System-config mode: 'label' names a device the hub's .cfg loaded. Inline mode: 'adapter' and 'device' make the manager load the device itself under 'label' (and unload it when it finalizes).

rs232device.description: Name of the 'micromanager.core' entry in rs232devices that owns the MMCore this device lives in.

label.description: Micro-Manager label of the State or Shutter device (a State device needs at least two positions). System-config mode: a device the hub's .cfg loaded (a typo is reported with the list of loaded State and Shutter devices). Inline mode: the label the new device gets.

states.description: State devices only: the two Micro-Manager positions (state labels, or state indices) used as logical state 0 and logical state 1. Default: position 0 is state 0 and position 1 is state 1. It only orders the two positions of a two-position device; a device with more than two positions exposes every position as the state of the same number, and 'states' is refused there. Refused for a Shutter (closed is 0, open is 1; use 'invert' to swap them).

adapter.description: Inline mode: Micro-Manager device adapter library (for example 'DemoCamera'). Must be given together with 'device'; leave both out when the .cfg already loads the label.

device.description: Inline mode: device name inside the adapter (for example 'DShutter' or 'DStateDevice'). Must be given together with 'adapter'.

parent.description: Inline mode: label of the hub device (Micro-Manager Hub) the device hangs off, when the adapter needs one.

preInitProperties.description: Inline mode: properties that can only be set before the device is initialised (Micro-Manager 'pre-init' properties, for example the 'Number of positions' of a demo State device), applied in order before initialisation.
